## History

Barbara Shaw arrived in [Brierley](../codex/places.md#brierley) to reside alongside her aunt, having previously only visited her aunt Mary during the prior winter.

_Sources: [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P6](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0006), [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033)_
